metadata.author: Kristo
metadata.description:
Ever looked up at the night sky and wondered what stories the stars are telling? This is no ordinary audio card - it's packed with dynamic content that creates a unique celestial adventure just for you! 

First, become a true explorer by learning four clever ways to find North, with dynamic instructions that adapt to your location and season.

Then, get ready for some real-time star tracking! Using your live location, the card knows exactly what's in the sky above you right now. It will guide you, moment by moment, to find four brilliant constellations twinkling in the heavens. You'll hear amazing myths and secret stories about each one, from mighty hunters to glittering jewels. 

And before you even step outside, the card checks your local weather to let you know if the stars are ready for their show! 

Ready for a new adventure every night? Let's explore the stars together!
